changeinfo.changes:
• Reduces launch time.
  • Unlock "New World Remulia" on the World Map.
  • System change: Defeated New World mystic bosses are now part of the regular summon lottery.
  • Only when you have new items in your mailbox, a ! icon will display in "Communicate" on the main menu.
  • When you receive a trade request, a balloon icon will appear in "Communicate" on the main menu.
  • Additional limit break for Limited Summon UC rarity Spirits (max level increased by 10).
  • Added rewards for party cost expansion according to the number of areas released (maximum party cost increased from 16.5 to 17.5).
  • System change: Support skills will be active even for Spirits rented from players who are not your friends.
  • Halved the rental costs of supporter Spirits.
  • Unified delivery time when a trade is established to 1 hour.
  • Upward adjustment of effects for a portion of spirit statuses.
  • Adjusted drop rate when defeating a New World boss.
  • Other adjustments and bug fixes.

• Unlocked "New World Atlantis" on the World Map.
  • Rarity R of upper-level summons, limited summons, 1 stage expansion of SR spirits' limit break (level max increased by 10).
  • Added a feature to change "Today's Element" with Destiny Orbs.
  • Added rewards for party cost expansion according to the number of areas released (maximum party cost increased from 16.0 to 16.5).
  • Other adjustments and bug fixes.

• Unlock "New World Mu" on the World Map.
  • Added new battle systems "Two Bosses" and "Boss Chain Battle".
  • Added "Neo World Summon".
  • Changed system so that the same Spirits can be synthesized if they have broken the max level. This will grant a status bonus.
  • The level max color will change depending on whether the max level limit has been broken.
  • Other adjustments and bug fixes.

• Continuous Summon feature added.
  • Battle Speed feature added.
  • Light and Dark Elements effects changed.
  • The World Map now shows the area played previously in the center of the screen.
  • Other adjustments and bug fixes.

• Upward adjustment of effects for a portion of spirit skills.
  • Other adjustments and bug fixes.

• Upward adjustment of spirit sales.
  • Upward adjustment of effects for a portion of spirit skills.
  • Adjustment of log-in decision.
  • Other adjustments and bug fixes.

• Added illustrations to options.
  • Added a function to collect all game money from the mailbox.
  • Added a trade button to the friend menu.
  • Changed the hunt location information collection timing.
  • Changed the graphics for the Sell button and Lock button.
  • Changed the total displayed number of persons for rankings.
  • Other adjustments and bug fixes.

• Shop functions.
  • Added a Spirit selling function.
  • Added a feature that lets Spirits break through their level limit when merging certain combinations.
  • Changed ranking to weekly rankings.
  • Changed the skill gauge to accumulate over time.
  • Other adjustments and bug fixes.
